page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-112 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the m4n server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 112 dedicated virtual central processing units and 1488.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-core ratio of approximately 13.29 GB of RAM per vCPU, designed specifically for memory-intensive workloads.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated graphics processing units. All storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning network routing must be configured externally or through paid address allocations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the m4n-megamem-112 is positioned as a high-density resource allocation instance. It trades off local storage and GPU acceleration to maximize memory capacity per vCPU. This makes the instance highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise workloads that do not require local disk caching or hardware acceleration.
